import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('docs/technical-reviews/artifacts/fact_finish_w_1')

from fetch_sources import fetch

factual_accuracy.details: 逐項核網站與Notebook定義、first-cell bootstrap、Git/uv contract、CPU config、啟用與CLI、Jupyter/kernel重跑；不是整節NA。實讀官方原文與本專案source，真CPU執行如artifacts。

numeric_verification.details: W.1沒有需核算的數值/統計/效能主張；節號、路徑、三行操作不是數學測值。字串還原與前置的實際輸出已作軟體核對，未假稱numeric或GPU實測。

figure_consistency.details: W.1無inline SVG；必要前置W.3 tensor_axes與1.1 character_ids本人讀完整XML後Inkscape渲染、view_image親看，數值/對齊/方向吻合；persistent PNG與receipt已保存。

source_verification.details: 官方uv/Git/Python3.13/IPython9.17.1/JupyterLab4.6.4/Colab FAQ/pip26.2.1原文已親讀定位，v4.6.4官方source/schema確認短鍵及Kernel menu。repo configs/source與全部來源snapshot/hash/執行outputs可追。 W.7在收到目前修訂後已本人完整重讀，current SHA另存；原read snapshot未覆寫。

limitations.details: 本輪不重裝deps、不clone、不重新kernel install；uv只frozen offline dry-run。Windows與Colab runtime未執行；Colab僅HTTP/官方文檔/原碼與mock dispatch；Notebook fresh+restart為真本機CPU短例。未驗GPU或長訓練；網路/服務/後續下載仍有其條件。

scope_notes: No fresh package install or clone; Git ls-remote, official docs and frozen offline dry-run only.
No cloud Colab kernel execution or Windows shell execution; Colab dispatch tested with subprocess/chdir mocked.
Only CPU short examples and kernels tested; no GPU benchmarks or long training.
Notebook original and bird edit were each executed in fresh local kernels; persistent state separately tested across actual local kernel restart.
W.1 has no inline figure; prerequisite W.3/1.1 figures were read in full XML and personally viewed after local rendering.
